name: humanizer
description: Install Humanizer as a Claude plugin.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Rewrite text so it reads as written by its author, removing AI writing tells (not-X-but-Y contrasts, one-line closers, staged openers, forced triads, puffery, -ing riders, stock AI vocabulary, bold labels, chatbot wrappers) while keeping the writer's voice and every claim, number and name at its original strength.
